attempts.prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster work-animation source for HARVEST THE NIGHT.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved farmer identity master; Image 2 is the approved idle_west strip for exact side-view face, hat, clothes, body scale and feet. Both are references, not edit targets.
Style/medium: coherent crisp pixel art with deliberate clusters and colored outlines, simple readable tools. Preserve straw hat with brown band, dark hair, cream rolled sleeves, blue bib overalls, brown boots and warm skin. Orthographic three-quarter top-down camera, facing WEST (left).
Composition: exactly FOUR complete sequential poses in ONE horizontal row, left to right. Equal-size square cells with generous actual transparent gutters and outer margins. No other figures or rows. Boots stay planted at the same baseline and horizontal body center within each cell. Same body/hat size throughout; do not center the combined character+tool bounds or resize a pose to fill its cell.
Runtime contract: every pose will be reduced to a 48x48 native canvas with body about 20x30 and feet at (24,44). Tools may extend about 16 pixels left and 12 above the hat within that canvas. Keep tool proportions compact enough to fit, without shrinking the farmer. Complete unclipped tool, simple one- or two-color readable metal head and wood handle.
Lighting/mood: neutral warm daytime, upper-left highlights, darker underside; no baked glow, contact effect, ground, crop, tree, rock, station or shadow.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparency including gutters, no checkerboard drawing. No text, labels, borders, watermark or UI. No blur, smooth painting, random speckle, duplicated hands/tools or extra limbs.

Primary request: Action CARRY: carry a small warm wooden CRATE at waist/chest, never a crate the size of the farmer. Poses 0 steady crate in both hands; 1 slight leftward body weight lean/arms adjusting crate; 2 small reverse weight lean, crate held securely; 3 upright recovery holding crate level. Both boots remain planted, distinct balance/arm poses without changing body size. Crate no lettering; no background.
The last pose recovers to the first to form a believable four-frame work cycle.
attempts.decision: Accepted: four distinct native frames; body scale, boot anchor, alpha, side silhouette and tool clearance reviewed on light/dark/checker backgrounds.

attempts.prompt_text:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent four-frame pixel-art farmer fishing/cast strip for a Godot game.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the rejected fishing strip. Image 2 is the approved farmer identity reference; image 3 is the accepted west idle body/outline reference.
Change only the fishing equipment geometry in the target strip: shorten the rod and its visible line in ALL four poses. Preserve the four ordered poses, hat, clothing, face, character dimensions, frame layout, feet and body silhouette. The rod plus line must never extend more than 0.65 of the farmer's standing hat-to-boot height to the left of the center between the boots. Total rod-plus-line height above the boot baseline must remain below 1.35 times the standing farmer height. In frame 1 (second pose), keep a forward cast with the compact rod bent forward; in frame 2 (third pose), show its low follow-through with the same compact rod and a short nearby bobber. Leave the rod identifiable, with a wooden handle, dark gray reel and red-white bobber. Use compact pixel clusters, one short line arc, no detached swish trails. Keep generous transparent gaps between all four frames and transparent outer margins. No background, ground, shadow, text, labels, grid, target, duplicate figures or fifth frame. Full clear pixel silhouette with upper-left highlights. Do not shrink the farmer to accommodate the fishing rod.
attempts.decision: Rejected: follow-through rod still needs 27px to the left of the foot anchor; only 24px available. Other poses fit; request second targeted revision of frame 2.

attempts.prompt_text:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Transparent four-frame pixel-art fishing animation strip.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Change ONLY the rod and line of the THIRD figure from the left (follow-through pose). Preserve every pixel and position of the farmers, and preserve the equipment of figures 1, 2 and 4. In figure 3 shorten the near-horizontal rod by 35 percent: move its tip and bobber toward the farmer's left hand, keeping the wooden rod slope and reel. The leftmost bobber pixel must be no farther left than the left edge of this figure's hat; the leftmost rod pixel must be no farther left than that hat edge too. Keep a short line to the red-white bobber just underneath the rod tip. No extra line arcs. This is necessary to fit a 48px canvas with a 30px farmer. Keep all four figures, transparent gutters and transparent outer margins unchanged. Do not crop, shrink, move or redraw any farmer. No extra figures, background, text, grid or shadows.
attempts.decision: Accepted: four distinct native frames; body scale, boot anchor, alpha, side silhouette and tool clearance reviewed on light/dark/checker backgrounds.
